description: A React component implementing a form modal for creating and configuring a vector store, with provider-specific fields, model fetching, validation, and UI interactions.

classes.name: VectorStoreForm
classes.description: React functional component providing a modal form to create or configure a vector store, with provider selection, metadata input, credential selection, and model fetching.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles form submission, parses metadata JSON, constructs payload with provider-specific fields, calls API to create vector store, and manages UI updates.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Resets form fields, state, and triggers modal close.
